fig_native_class_retention.layout: grouped bars: 7 class groups, 3 dataset bars per group (offsets -0.26, 0, +0.26; bar width 0.26*0.92)

y.name: HF retention (E_hi/E_tot)_sparse / (E_hi/E_tot)_dense, b0=16
y.scale: linear, from 0 to 1.22 × max(p75, median, diamond) over all bars

encoding.bar: R^{(c)}_{16}: diffusion estimator, MEDIAN over frames; fill = dataset color alpha 0.9
encoding.whiskers: IQR p25–p75 of the per-frame values (numpy percentile, linear interpolation), color #333333, capsize 2.5
encoding.diamond: HFR^{(c)}: KPM per-class true-HF share ratio sparse/dense, MEDIAN over frames; black 'D' marker
encoding.n_label: text 'n=<n>' at y=0.03, rotated 90°: n = frames where the class is valid (diffusion count)
encoding.printed_label: value printed above each bar = max(p75, median, diamond), format {:.3f}, rotated 90° — NOT the median
